description: 对实际原记录给出有限来源裁决，保存完整事实和下一独立本地候选；不拟合、不替代DR。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_dr007_official_history_catalog_probe_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save_new(name,o):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已存在，不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
proto=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for r in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/r['path'])==r['sha256']
log=json.loads((OUT/'request_ledger.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(log)==4 and all(r['http_status']==200 and not r['credential_used'] for r in log)
for r in log:assert sha(ROOT/r['raw_path'])==r['sha256']
data=json.loads((OUT/'raw_03_月报品种原数据.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
notes=json.loads((OUT/'raw_04_月报口径备注.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
codes=[r['typeEN'] for r in data['records']]
assert 'R007' in codes and 'DR007' not in codes
options=json.loads(data['data']['optionJson'])
months=sorted(y+'-'+m for y,ms in options.items() for m in ms.split(','))
remarks=BeautifulSoup(notes['data']['rmkCn'],'html.parser').get_text(' ',strip=True)
facts={'checked_at':now(),'actual_month':data['data']['showYearMonth'],'actual_rows':data['records'],'actual_codes':codes,'amount_unit':'亿元','frequency':'月度','offered_months':months,'earliest_offered_month':months[0],'latest_offered_month':months[-1],'offered_month_count':len(months),'fixed_old_date':proto['fixed_historical_sample_date'],'old_date_offered_by_month_menu':proto['fixed_historical_sample_date'][:7] in months,'note_plaintext':remarks,'note_source_url':log[3]['url'],'monthly_history_post_route_located':'https://www.chinamoney.com.cn/ags/ms/cm-u-query-mlrp/PrMthBltn','monthly_history_post_invoked':False,'monthly_component_same_as_daily_dr_universe':False,'source_head_timestamp_is_first_publication':False,'current_snapshot_not_first_vintage_authenticated':True}
save_new('实际品种_月度菜单_机构双边口径.json',facts)
gate={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'checked_at':now(),'status':'NOT_ADMITTED_MONTHLY_R_SCOPE_AND_OFFERED_MENU_DO_NOT_SUPPORT_ORIGINAL_DAILY_DR007_INPUT','same_required_dr007_identity':False,'same_daily_frequency':False,'fixed_20200804_actual_dr_amount_rows':0,'original_1212_decisions_and_all_mature_members_supported':False,'amount_historical_publication_clock_established':False,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'conclusion_scope':'只否定本次实际成交概览月报路径作为原日度DR输入；菜单不证明所有官方档案不存在，也未查询早于菜单的月API。','scientific_dr_amount_hypothesis_tested':False,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0}
save_new('source_gate.json',gate)
nextp={'experiment_id':'E36','status':'PROPOSED_LOCAL_PURCHASE_QUANTITY_SOURCE_REVIEW_NOT_YET_REGISTERED','question':'相同订单/资金背景下，制造业采购量这一不同业务行动的当月水平与月度变化，是否提供原八变量之外的联合条件信息？','prior_use':'当前代码/配置定位仅旧15个月CPI经济背景解析；公司采购现金流是不同研究对象；不复活CPI、库存差或制造业价格规则。','source_first':'仅已存132当月原报告采购量列，保留原版本限制；完整原1212决定日/成熟成员、原订单源时钟通过才另登记模型。','future_fixed_candidate':'原八变量+采购量水平/采购量月度变化；原504日/252成熟、深3叶60、岭alpha10、五日净标签/80线/两期/五门保持；0基准重拟合、0新标签/账户/源码。','new_source_requests':0,'new_model_registered':False,'not_a_dr007_amount_proxy':True,'old_dr_source_failures_preserved':True,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','goal_achieved':False}
save_new('next_experiment.json',nextp)
result={'study_id':proto['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E35','completed_at':now(),'status':'COMPLETED_OFFICIAL_MONTHLY_CATALOG_DIFFERENT_SCOPE_ORIGINAL_DR_HISTORY_NOT_ADMITTED','classification':'PROGRESS_E35_ACTUAL_MONTHLY_R_IDENTITY_RANGE_AND_TWO_SIDED_STATS_ESTABLISHED','web_search_queries':1,'new_public_requests':4,'new_raw_objects':4,'bytes':sum(r['bytes'] for r in log),'authenticated_provider_requests':0,'old_daily_endpoint_retries':0,'historical_dr_amount_rows':0,'actual_monthly_code':'R007 not DR007','frequency':'MONTHLY_NOT_DAILY','offered_month_range':[months[0],months[-1]],'offered_months':len(months),'institution_amount_semantics':'机构买卖方向交易的总和，不能命名为净融资或净流入。','source_gate':gate['status'],'new_labels':0,'new_fits':0,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','scientific_dr_amount_hypothesis_tested':False,'goal_achieved':False,'root_impasse_proven':False,'specific_expired_access_encounter_goal_turns':2,'global_consecutive_no_progress_goal_turns':0,'next_safe_action':R+'/next_experiment.json','current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'report':R+'/官方成交概览为何不能补齐DR历史_研究结论.md'}
save_new('result.json',result)
report=['# E35：官方成交概览不能补齐原DR007日度成交额','',
'4个实际公开对象均HTTP200，原字节和字段保留。成交概览对应质押式回购月报；品种原数据包含R001/R007等十个品种及合计，没有DR007。数据是月度金额，当前展示'+facts['actual_month']+'；所列菜单为'+months[0]+'—'+months[-1]+'，共'+str(len(months))+'个月。','',
'固定2020-08-04不在所列菜单。因为总体/频率已不符，未请求旧日，不以换月份、把R007当DR007或缩原成员使源门通过。菜单范围不是全部官方历史不存在的证明。','',
'官方备注说明月初更新上月统计，且机构统计为买卖两个方向交易总和。备注不提供每期精确首次公布时刻；当次head.ts不被视为历史首版时钟，机构量也不被叫做净流入。','',
'本路径作为原DR输入未准入，成交额经济假设仍未检验。本轮新拟合/标签/账户/源码修改0，夏普NOT_COMPUTED、目标未达。旧到期配置和日报接口均未重试。','',
'下一独立候选是已存制造业采购量，描述不同业务行动，不替代DR成交额；先核同当月行、原订单时钟和全部原训练支持，再决定是否登记固定联合评分。原CPI/库存/价格/外需及DR来源裁决保持。','',
'[实际请求](request_ledger.json)、[全部月报原数据](raw_03_月报品种原数据.json)、[统计备注](raw_04_月报口径备注.json)、[身份与菜单](实际品种_月度菜单_机构双边口径.json)、[来源门](source_gate.json)、[结果](result.json)、[E36提案](next_experiment.json)。']
(OUT/'官方成交概览为何不能补齐DR历史_研究结论.md').write_text('\n'.join(report)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'E35':'来源问题已结束','实际总体':'月度R007等','菜单范围':[months[0],months[-1]],'DR历史准入':False,'新增拟合':0,'下一安全行动':'采购量原字段完整支持核对'},ensure_ascii=False))
